m: सं-डीन n. (√ डि) flying together (one of the modes of flight attributed to birds), MBh.
a: संडीनं — One of the several modes of flight of birds; see डीन.

m: संडीनोड्डीन n. a partic. mode of flight (a combination of prec. and उड्-डीन, ‘flying up’; accord. to some ‘flying well’), ib.
संडीविन् m. (perhaps w.r. for सं-जीविन्, q.v.) N. of a minister of the crow-king Megha-varṇa, Kathās.
संडिश (?) m. (= सं-दंश) a pair of tongs or nippers, L.
a: संडिशः — A pair of tongs or nippers.
